rationale: Smallest opening cover of a series (warehouse x product), in days of OBSERVED demand. Each series draws its own cover between opening_days_min and opening_days_max from a hash of (warehouse, product): a min-max policy in steady state sits anywhere between its reorder point and its target, never all at the same point. One cover for every series (7 days until CR-017) made 66% of the 17,397 series reorder on the same day. Above reorder_point_days, so no series starts already needing an order. No source in this repository measures stock.
